import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

rows = [json.loads(s) for s in Path('train/data/train.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
counts = {}
for name, selected in [('all', rows), ('dagger_retained_prefix', rows[:4000])]:
    counts[name] = dict.fromkeys(('dice', 'cards', 'unknown'), 0)
    for row in selected:
        text = json.dumps(row['messages']).lower()
        game = 'dice' if 'dice' in text else 'cards' if 'cards' in text else 'unknown'
        counts[name][game] += 1
record = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'verify the registered DAgger prefix retains both games before collection; source-defined split audit only'}, '32f3e8ecf65426fc3306969496342d504bfa13f3'),
          'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'counts': counts,
          'data_sha256': file_sha256('train/data/train.jsonl'),
          'generator_sha256': file_sha256('train/make_sft_data.py'),
          'protocol_sha256': file_sha256('results/protocol.json'),
          'split_ranges_from_generator_and_protocol': {'teacher_train': [10000, 10799], 'teacher_validation': [60000, 60039], 'dagger': [30000, 30149], 'policy_validation': [80000, 80099], 'fresh_test': [200, 399]},
          'limitation': 'Game counts classified from complete prompt text; seed ranges checked from source/protocol, not per-row seed metadata (demonstration JSONL stores messages only).'}
Path('results/training/dagger_prefix_audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print(counts)
